_about: MCP eval cases (scoreboard/mcp_eval.py). question = what a renter types into a chatbot with HomeRule connected. facts = groups of alternatives (case-insensitive substrings); a fact counts as hit when any alternative appears in the final answer. Expected facts come from HomeRule's own data (web/data/live) and the scoreboard key (scoreboard/questions.yaml). ideal = the tool path a well-designed server needs (new design).
